title: Evercore ISI Ranked No. 1 on Weighted Basis in 2026 Extel All-America Research Analyst Survey
summary: Evercore ISI ranked No. 1 among all firms on a weighted basis in the analyst rankings of the 2026 Extel (previously Institutional Investor) All-America Research Team survey, marking its fifth consecutive year in the top position. The weighted ranking assigns greater value to higher placements, with first-place rankings contributing more than second- and third-place rankings.
